solutions.latex:
$$\begin{aligned}y&=x^4-8x^3+18x^2+4\\\frac{dy}{dx}&=4x^3-24x^2+36x\\\frac{d^2y}{dx^2}&=12x^2-48x+36\end{aligned}$$

For possible points of inflexion, let $\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2}=0$

$$\begin{aligned}0&=12x^2-48x+36\\x^2-4x+3&=0\\(x-3)(x-1)&=0\\\therefore x&=1\text{ or }x=3\end{aligned}$$

For horizontal point of inflexion, value of $x$ will also be stationary point

When $x=1$,

$$\frac{dy}{dx}=4(1)^3-24(1)^2+36(1)=16$$

When $x=3$,

$$\frac{dy}{dx}=4(3)^3-24(3)^2+36(3)=0$$

Check for change of concavity:

$$\begin{array}{c|ccc}x & 2.9 & 3 & 3.1\\\hline\dfrac{d^2y}{dx^2} & \dfrac{-57}{25} & 0 & \dfrac{63}{25}\end{array}$$

When $x=3$,

$$\begin{aligned}y&=3^4-8(3)^3+18(3)^2+4\\&=31\end{aligned}$$

$\therefore(3,31)$ is a horizontal point of inflexion.

solutions.latex:
Let $B$ be the area of the blue region

Let $W$ be the area of the small rectangle

Let $R$ be the area of the big rectangle

$$\begin{aligned}B&=\int_a^b x^n\,dx\\&=\frac{1}{n+1}\left[x^{n+1}\right]_a^b\\&=\frac{1}{n+1}\left(b^{n+1}-a^{n+1}\right)\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}W&=a\times a^n\\&=a^{n+1}\\R&=b\times b^n\end{aligned}$$

$$\begin{aligned}R&=B+3B+W\\&=4B+W\\b^{n+1}&=\frac{4}{n+1}\left(b^{n+1}-a^{n+1}\right)+a^{n+1}\\b^{n+1}-a^{n+1}&=\frac{4}{n+1}\left(b^{n+1}-a^{n+1}\right)\\1&=\frac{4}{n+1}\\n+1&=4\\n&=3\end{aligned}$$
solutions.marks_breakdown: 4: ; 1 mark for blue area; 1 mark for rectangle areas; 1 mark for setting up equation with relationship between areas; 1 mark for correct value
